Personality: Serious. Close relationship with Bamboo. Has been watching Bamboo since enrollment
Watch ooooout!!

Alright, looking great today too!!
Thank you very much, Instructor!!

Yes, thorough stretching as always. Now, I have to go check on
another student... so please make sure not to overwork yourself.
Yes, sir!!

"Run in the hallways"... As if embodying that very Tracen Academy
motto, Bamboo Memory dashed off into the distance.

Bamboo Memory!
Disciplinary Committee head of Tracen Academy!!

...Understood, just be sure not to overexert yourself.
Now then, shall we clean up?

If I recall, she's an Umamusume who hasn't debuted yet.
Getting saved by her must be fate. It might be worth keeping an eye on her.

...Understood. In that case, for now!
For now, I'll continue my dirt training just like before.

The Event Tournament—a major Tracen Academy event held biannually.
Every student at the academy can register and run in any event of their choice.

Bamboo Memory tears across the turf training track.
Her running is powerful yet nimble—truly magnificent speed.

After a thorough warm-up, Bamboo Memory
began running on the dirt track.
And so, without exception, the instructor departed as well, but—

Watch where you're going from now on! Make sure not to bump into anyone!
I need you to use the hallways safely, securely, and full of vigor! Farewell!!

Just one lap is all I ask, I want to run all-out on the turf track!!
I'm in top form today, and look at my hooves!

...True, it seems fine right now. That said, as an instructor,
I can only give you general advice. Are you alright with that?

...I won't stop you, but I still can't recommend it.
Your hooves are more fragile than average, Bamboo-san.

I don't mind at all! I'd really appreciate it!!
Alright! Here I goooo!
Aw, c'mon! They've been holding up great lately, haven't they!?

Bamboo Memory diligently threw herself into the plain basics just as instructed,
without uttering a single word of complaint.

A rookie Trainer's work involves a lot of learning and is unexpectedly busy.
That day, too, I was walking along with my eyes fixed on paperwork when—

If she's prioritizing her legs, easing them in slowly like the instructor
said is the safest path, but—

If she increases turf training, which strains hooves more than dirt,
she'll need someone constantly monitoring the condition of her hooves.
Yes, what is it?

...An Umamusume was sprinting right across my path.
If I hadn't come to a halt, we might have collided...

If we could do that, it'd be one thing... but in my position as an instructor,
I can't be glued to your side the entire time.

But I... I still don't want to completely give up on the next Event Tournament.
I'm sorry!
More!

Good work today, Instructor!
Do you have some time today too!?

Precisely because they love running so much, quite a few Umamusume
neglect their fundamentals. Even more so when training alone.

Why dirt? Her running showed such undeniable turf aptitude
that it made me question her current path.

Instructors are responsible for overseeing many Umamusume at once.
The time they can dedicate to any single person is inevitably limited.

With this, for the next Event Tournament!!
Don't you think I can enter the turf division!?
I couldn't help feeling as though her sights were set on something even further beyond.
Ah, so sorry!

Even pre-debut Umamusume can compete against debuted seniors.
It's a rare opportunity that draws significant attention from outside the academy.

Is there "something" so important that she refuses to give it up despite the risks...?
No matter how much I pondered, I couldn't find a clear answer that day.

...The choice is yours, but... I believe it's best to build up your body for now
and aim to transition to turf after your debut.

A few days after that thought crossed my mind—
After school, I spotted Bamboo Memory doing warm-ups out on the grounds.

28, 29, 30!
Alright, next! 8 more sets!
*pant*... *pant*... *pant*... *whew*!

Many Umamusume wish to race on turf rather than dirt. That's because turf
is undeniably more prestigious in terms of high-profile races and overall popularity.

Bamboo-san, let's wrap things up soon.
It's getting late, so let's call it a day.
*pant*, *pant*, *pant*, *pant*—!

Are you alright!?
You shouldn't walk while distracted! You're not hurt, right?

Look!! Take a look, Instructor!!
My hooves don't hurt at all, and there are no cracks either!!
